description: Microsoft Teams HITL approval gate. Slack analog — same asset + sensor shape, same JSON token format. target: human_approval_gate (default) composes with HumanApprovalGateComponent via shared `approval_dir`; target: agentic_pipeline watches agentic_pipeline's own approve/mode:park review queue directly. Uses MS Graph API with a DELEGATED OAuth token (app-only/client-credentials does not work for sending a channel message, confirmed against Microsoft's own docs) — a one-time interactive consent captures a refresh token, which this component refreshes (and persists if Microsoft rotates it) on every poll, pure outbound HTTPS. Two approval modes: `reactions` (default; approvers react with a built-in Teams emoji — like/heart/laugh/surprised/sad/angry, limited to 6) OR `reply` (approvers post a thread reply containing a configured keyword like APPROVE/REJECT — more flexible, allows context in the same message). Multi-approver quorum + allowlist + timeout policies (escalate / reject / approve). Sensor polls Teams API every `poll_interval_seconds` and writes the standard JSON approval token on quorum. Works without a public webhook (unlike Teams Adaptive Card interactive buttons) — deployable to Dagster+ Serverless with no infra changes.

inputs.description: Upstream asset's text is posted to Teams for approval.

outputs.description: One `{asset_name}_posted` asset (records the Teams message ID + sidecar state) + one `{asset_name}_watcher` sensor (polls votes + writes the approval token on quorum).

upstream_asset_key.description: target: human_approval_gate only (required there, ignored for target: agentic_pipeline). Upstream asset whose text is posted to Teams for approval.
upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key

approval_dir.label: Approval Dir
approval_dir.description: Shared with HumanApprovalGateComponent — token file lands as `{safe_partition_key}.json`. Accepts local paths (`/tmp/approvals`) OR cloud URIs (`s3://bucket/prefix`, `gs://bucket/prefix`, `abfs://...`). Cloud URIs require the matching fsspec driver (`s3fs` / `gcsfs` / `adlfs`) — required for Dagster+ Serverless or distributed deploys where the local filesystem isn't shared across containers.

teams_tenant_id_env_var.description: Env var holding the Azure AD tenant id.
teams_tenant_id_env_var.label: Tenant ID Env Var

teams_client_id_env_var.description: Env var holding the Azure AD app registration client id.
teams_client_id_env_var.label: Client ID Env Var

teams_client_secret_env_var.description: Env var holding the Azure AD app registration client secret.
teams_client_secret_env_var.label: Client Secret Env Var

teams_team_id.description: Teams team id (from Teams client → team → three-dot menu → Get link).
teams_team_id.label: Teams Team ID

teams_channel_id.description: Teams channel id inside the team (e.g. `19:xxx@thread.tacv2`).
teams_channel_id.label: Teams Channel ID

mode.description: 'reactions' (default; approvers react with the configured emoji — Teams limits to 6 built-ins: like, heart, laugh, surprised, sad, angry) OR 'reply' (approvers post a thread reply containing the configured keyword — more flexible, allows context).
mode.label: Mode

approve_reaction.label: Approve Reaction
approve_reaction.description: Reaction type for approval. One of: like, heart, laugh, surprised, sad, angry.

approve_reply_keyword.description: Keyword (case-insensitive) that marks a reply as an approval vote (mode='reply').
approve_reply_keyword.label: Approve Reply Keyword

reject_reply_keyword.description: Keyword (case-insensitive) that marks a reply as a rejection vote.
reject_reply_keyword.label: Reject Reply Keyword

required_approvers.description: How many allowlisted approvers must vote-approve before the token is written.
required_approvers.label: Required Approvers

approver_allowlist.label: Approver Allowlist
approver_allowlist.description: Azure AD object IDs (GUIDs) allowed to vote.

timeout_hours.description: Optional. If quorum isn't reached within this many hours, applies `on_timeout` policy.
timeout_hours.label: Timeout Hours

escalate_teams_user.description: Azure AD object ID pinged when timeout escalates. Only used when `on_timeout: escalate`.
escalate_teams_user.label: Escalate Teams User

poll_interval_seconds.description: Sensor cadence — how often to poll Teams for new votes. Default 60s (Teams API is rate-limited; 30s is fine for a handful of partitions but pump higher at scale).
poll_interval_seconds.label: Poll Interval Seconds

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'static', 'multi', 'dynamic', or None for unpartitioned.

partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'customer_a,customer_b,customer_c'.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.
partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: Passed through to the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition. 0 (the Dagster default) means a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows -- e.g. a daily set never includes today until tomorrow. Set to 1 to include the current, still-in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition (defaults to UTC when unset, matching Dagster's own default).

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset. 'single_run' sends ONE approval request covering the whole backfill range (the range's partition keys are joined into a single request/sidecar-state key, so one approve/reject decision applies to the entire range as a unit) rather than one request per partition. 'multi_run' launches one run -- and one separate approval request -- per partition. Leave empty for Dagster's default (one run per partition, uncapped). Ignored when Partition Type is not set.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Max Partitions Per Run
backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.description: For Backfill Policy = 'multi_run' only: maximum partitions materialized per run. Leave empty for Dagster's default (1).

target.label: Target
target.description: 'human_approval_gate' (default): post `upstream_asset_key`'s text, write a bare decision token for a separately-configured `HumanApprovalGateComponent` to consume -- unchanged from this component's original behavior. 'agentic_pipeline': instead of posting an upstream asset, watch `<approval_dir>/pending/*.json` records -- the review queue agentic_pipeline's own `approve` op writes when it has `mode: park` -- post each pending record's `summary`, and on quorum write the decision the same way agentic_pipeline's own `approve_pending()` reviewer-tooling helper does (copies the pending record's fingerprint into the token). `upstream_asset_key` is ignored in this mode; no asset is emitted, only the watcher sensor.

teams_refresh_token_env_var.label: Teams Refresh Token Env Var
teams_refresh_token_env_var.description: Env var holding the INITIAL OAuth refresh token (from the one-time interactive consent for the dedicated approval-bot account -- see this file's module docstring, 'Auth'). Only the seed -- if Microsoft ever rotates it, the rotated token is persisted to `<approval_dir>/.teams_oauth_state.json` and preferred over this env var from then on.
